method: Six-frame idle row only. Fit premultiplied RGB and alpha under translation versus frame 0. Core excludes the outer 17% horizontal width, top 12%, and bottom 26% to reduce limbs and ground contacts; full silhouette fit is an independent cross-check. Search +/-40 px X and +/-18 px Y. All figures are runtime sheet pixels. Translation includes both intentional animation and unwanted packing drift, and changes in anatomy can bias fits. These are visual-review flags, not automatic corrections, acceptance, or proof of registration quality.
